description: List users belonging to an owner (org), optionally filtered by activation/admin/search. Codecov REST: GET /{service}/{owner_username}/users/.

activated.description: Filter by whether the user's seat is activated.

owner.description: Owner username — the organization or user login on the git service, e.g. 'codecov' (required).

pageSize.description: Number of results per page (maps to `page_size`).

search.description: Free-text search over user name / username.

service.description: Git service provider — one of 'github' (default), 'gitlab', 'bitbucket', 'github_enterprise', 'gitlab_enterprise' or 'bitbucket_server'.

name: codecov_list_users
title: List users
